description: We are here for the experience
summary: We developed a resource management/survival game that takes place in an outpost on Mars. It involves real data and stations created from research, therefore providing a realistic and challenging enviroment to navigate through.
details: We developed a resource management/survival game that takes place in an outpost on Mars. Using NASA's data we adjusted the weather and radiaton conditions to represent real records. On top of this data we collected information about how astronauts survive in similar outposts (mostly considered Mars harsh circumstances) and we implemented them into our game as challenges against the mission, which is to collect data. We based everything around our target audience (7-12 year olds) and based both imagery and language to something they would find appealing so much themselves as their parents. For the technical part we relied heavily on the use of SI considering the limited time we had for the project, in hopes we could have a functioning demo on time. Through our game we hope to educate children on the challenges, the limited resources and the "sacrifices" made to research unknow ground astronauts face on missions, resulting to peaking their interest towards space.
